name: Rinnai ducted air conditioning
tagline: Whole-home reverse-cycle ducted heating and cooling with optional zoning.
summary: The Rinnai Ducted Reverse Cycle Inverter (DRCi) system heats and cools the whole home through insulated ductwork, with the indoor unit hidden in the roof space.
It comes in six sizes from 7 kW to 18 kW, uses R32 refrigerant, and can be zoned so you only condition the rooms in use.

image.alt: Rinnai ducted air conditioning outdoor unit beside a wall

highlights.title: Whole-home comfort
highlights.text: One concealed system heats, cools and dehumidifies every room through ceiling outlets.

highlights.title: Optional zoning
highlights.text: The optional Rinnai Home controller manages up to 8 zones with a touch screen and wireless sensors.

highlights.title: Wi-Fi app control
highlights.text: Switch the system on and adjust temperature and fan speed from the Android or Apple app.

highlights.title: Quiet operation
highlights.text: Efficient fans and a DC inverter compressor keep noise low without affecting performance.

highlights.title: DC inverter efficiency
highlights.text: The inverter varies its speed to hold a steady temperature and conserve energy.

highlights.title: Auto restart
highlights.text: The system restarts by itself after a power outage.
